A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CPDet3D paper, including the complete supplementary material in Sections 6–9. Text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original detection results on ScanNet V2, SUN RGB-D, and KITTI, plus ablations and supplementary experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, ablations, and supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: Prototype mining, optimal transport matching, cooperative refinement, training losses, and the supplementary detector adaptations are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same indoor and outdoor 3D detection coverage using ScanNet V2, SUN RGB-D, and KITTI.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 and supplementary comparisons retain identical comparator membership, including SparseDet, CoIn/CoIn++, DQS3D, and the detector baselines.

E3.justification: Data splits, annotation budgets, detector settings, evaluation metrics, and supplementary protocols are unchanged, including the alternative annotation settings in Section 8.1.

E4.justification: Label-quality analyses, component ablations, hyperparameter sweeps, annotation analyses, and the comparison against GT sampling are retained unchanged. Figure 8's formatting changes do not alter its sensitivity analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The label statistics in Section 4.4 are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 1 retains CPDet3D's mAP@0.25/mAP@0.5 values of 56.1/40.8 on ScanNet V2 and 60.2/43.3 on SUN RGB-D; Figure 8's plotted values also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(11), including the matching, prototype-update, label-selection, and loss definitions, are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same unified indoor/outdoor detection contributions and claims of approximately 78%, 90%, and 96% of fully supervised performance.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and interpretations of the experiments are unchanged. Section 9 retains the limitations concerning specialized network design and difficult distant objects.

D1.justification: Section 4.2's implementation frameworks and hyperparameters, supplementary adaptation details, and the code-availability link are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, novelty positioning, and bibliography are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 27 March 2025 to v2 dated 13 June 2025. Article wording, headings, and section structure are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 8 has revised legend typography and slightly adjusted plot sizing and placement. Its curves, numerical labels, and legend meanings remain unchanged; all other figures, tables, and supplementary layouts match.

improvement.justification: The revision updates the arXiv stamp and makes minor cosmetic adjustments to Figure 8, which is legible in both versions. Methods, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and limitations—including the supplementary material—remain unchanged, so overall paper quality does not meaningfully change.
